diagnosis.armpit_webbing: XFER weight transfer left chaotic blends along full arm chain (e.g. forearm verts 50% bound to static Shoulder bone). Previous repairArmpitWeights only targeted 0.28m radius around shoulder - missed verts 0.5m+ out. Root cause: static Shoulder bone never rotates in mocap; any Shoulder weight on arm verts tears proportionally.
diagnosis.black_ribbons: Not hair (verified: persists with Head/Neck hidden). Distinct strip mesh; not affected by arm skinning. Likely clothing strap/accessory with UV issues. Needs separate identification.
diagnosis.texture_stretching: Source asset issue - Tripo 2048x2048 texture with stretched UV islands. Not fixable via weights; requires re-UV or repaint.
diagnosis.unnatural_arm_angles: Walk-test uses REAL CMU mocap (banks.cmu['walk']), NOT procedural. Unnatural look comes from broken skin weights tearing the mesh, not the animation source.

fix.method: Full arm-chain re-skin: tube around Shoulder->Elbow->Wrist->Hand polyline for clean segment weights; fold-zone verts moved to Shoulder; strip small static-Shoulder weights from arm-dominated verts; finger verts (Unused17/18/19) untouched.
fix.metric: webbing verts (>0.15m displacement on 90° arm raise): 545 -> 198 (64% reduction). Max tear: 0.515m -> 0.336m.

remaining: 198 verts still exceed 0.15m (legitimate fold blend band + 4-way messy blends at wrist)
